description: This file defines the AuthService class, which provides methods for user authentication including login, logout, token storage, and retrieval of user information. It interacts with an API client for server communication and uses shared preferences for local data persistence.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Singleton class providing authentication related services such as login, logout, and user info retrieval.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login with email and password, stores tokens and user info, and returns user email on success.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears stored tokens and user info to log out the user.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if there is a valid access token stored indicating an authenticated user.

methods.name: currentUserEmail
methods.description: Retrieves the stored email of the current user, or null if not available.
